description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines underscore utilities, Google Analytics setup, and a Learn class for fetching and displaying project info and issues, as well as some utility functions.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for managing and displaying project information, including fetching issue counts and appending info to the DOM.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Appends project info to the DOM, customizing links based on backend or local demo.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches and displays the number of open issues from GitHub.
